messages.content: Repair the rejected story arc required-event list. Fix the listed issue and enforce the supplied repair invariants without changing unrelated source meaning. Return JSON only.

SOURCE STORY
A realistic action film about a woman, Amy, protecting her two kids (Will and Amber) from a zombie apocalypse.
Amy is at home on a normal day, wearing a tight, black tank top and denim jeans, cooking breakfast for her young kids.
Suddenly, a zombie breaks the kitchen door window and Amy sees the danger. She rushes her kids to the basement, gets them inside, and then locks the door.
She retrieves her hidden arsenal consisting of a pistol and a katana. She equips the weapons.
The majority of the film is Amy killing (dismembering, decapitating, etc.) zombies as they try and attack her.
Amy kills the last of the zombies, her house now soaked in blood. She lets her kids out of the basement.

DEFINED SUBJECTS
<Subject 1> = Amy
<Subject 2> = Will
<Subject 3> = Amber

TOTAL BEATS
8

MAJORITY REPAIR BUDGET
At least 5/8 beats must belong to the emphasized sequence; at most 3 beats may sit before/outside it, so that sequence must begin no later than Beat 4. Fit earlier setup/preparation inside those 3 beats by bundling adjacent source actions when needed. Preparation before the sequence does not count. Keep the calm baseline separate from the sudden inciting change. Combine terminal fight + immediate resolution in Beat 8 if necessary.

Rules:
- Fix the validator issue AND enforce every rule below across the corrected list, even if a violated rule was not named by the validator.
- Preserve every explicit source action/state in source order.
- Keep exactly one required_event per global beat.
- A finite source activity assigned wholly to one beat must be a complete clip job reaching a natural visible endpoint; progressive/in-progress wording alone is invalid. The endpoint may state only the ordinary result implied by completing the activity.
- Split or regroup only adjacent source actions when needed to fix allocation.
- Preserve the explicit calm baseline before the sudden inciting threat/change.
- Every event after the first depends_on the immediately previous event ID.
- Preserve existing persistent state_effects unless changed event meaning requires moving them; do not invent temporary/inferred conditions.
- Return exactly 8 corrected events covering Beats 1-8.

Return JSON only with an events array.
